caseFindings.proposition: The Sydney Opera House opened in 1973.
caseFindings.finding: Two accessible substantive institutional accounts directly state or describe the 1973 opening. The third selected article is blocked, not confirmed. No incorrect context identified in the two accessible passages.
caseFindings.independenceQualification: Distinct institutions and separately composed narratives, but NMA cites the ABC/Sydney Opera House history project among other references. Some shared historical provenance is visible; do not characterize the sources as wholly independent primary records. NMA also describes its commemorative opening plaque.

caseFindings.proposition: There are eight planets in the Solar System.
caseFindings.finding: All five selected URLs opened and substantively agree on eight under the IAU classification. No incorrect context identified for that ordinary classification claim. NASA/JPL contributes one family despite two URLs.
sourceFamilies: IAU Office of Astronomy for Education
caseFindings.independenceQualification: At least two distinct substantive editorial families (e.g., NASA/JPL and separately authored Timeanddate or Sky & Telescope) agree; no article-level syndication observed. All rely on the same underlying IAU classification, not independent measurements proving an exact cosmic census.
caseFindings.scopeQualification: Recognized Solar System planets under the IAU definition, excluding dwarf planets; not a proof that an undiscovered additional planet cannot exist.
